precedence.argument: A docket is the union of its members; if any member is replay-derived the artifact cannot attest model provenance (one producer field, at most one model id). 'mixed' would let a reader treat the model share as provable mined provenance it cannot prove. Mislabelling replay as mixed risks a false provenance claim; mislabelling a partly-model docket as replay only understates. Asymmetric error -> conservative.
